phase: Bounded metadata ranking and current-first-party evidence preflight
scopeBoundary: The 835 Priority-D outstanding records were not processed sequentially. Metadata first reduced them to 90 active candidates with 150-1,000 capacity and an officialFacilityUrl or discoveryUrl, then selected the ten dedicated-hall/theater candidates below after excluding canonical facility-space records with formal dispositions. Current first-party research checked ranks 1-5 only. No seat transcription, source creation, production integration, generated artifact, fingerprint, or deploy was performed.
policyBasis: ADOPT requires current/current-linked issuer-numbered material, a supported representative configuration, a complete printed set, and issuer-defined ownership/subtotal. No IDs, gaps, ownership, or totals may be invented from geometry or capacity. A Sol candidate additionally requires current complete numbered material and only an ownership/subtotal/printed-count reconciliation blocker.
